item.title: Indian shares set to open higher on foreign inflows as AI selloff persists
item.description: GIFT Nifty futures were at 25,912 points, as of 7:58 a.m. IST, indicating a positive start for the benchmark Nifty 50 index, which closed at 25,800.6 on Friday.

item.title: Gold Rebounds as Tech Rout Spurs Shift to Havens, Treasury Rally
item.description: Gold rebounded from its biggest weekly decline in eight months as a technology-stock rout pushed traders to seek haven assets, driving down US Treasury yields and the dollar.

item.title: MSCI Discussed Avoiding Indonesia Downgrade With Prabowo, Dalio
item.description: MSCI Inc. Chief Executive Henry Fernandez conveyed a willingness to consider alternatives to a two-step downgrade of Indonesia’s stock-market status in recent direct talks with President Prabowo Subianto, according to people with knowledge of the discussion.

item.title: Current rally in large-caps a bear market one: veteran investor Shankar Sharma
item.description: Sharma calls the recent market rally a countertrend move, remains bullish on small-caps and says foreign buying reflects tactical allocation shifts, not renewed faith in India.

item.title: Top stocks to watch today: Tata Steel, APL Apollo Tubes, Maruti Suzuki, RVNL, Waaree Energies & 17 others in focus
item.description: Indian equities climbed to nine-month highs last week despite a wider Asian selloff, as foreign investment flowed into the market. Key corporate updates include Tata Steel’s proposed asset sales, large renewable-energy and infrastructure deals, and new orders for several listed companies.

item.title: China State Funds Ramp Up ETF Buying to Record as Rout Deepens
item.description: China’s state-backed funds poured a record amount of money into the market on Friday in another forceful attempt to stem a deepening selloff.

item.title: Treasury Futures Fall as Rising Stock Futures Damp Haven Demand
item.description: US Treasury futures declined as demand for havens waned on signs that the recent selloff in equities may be drawing some buyers back.

item.title: Stock market outlook today,23 Nov:Sensex, Nifty prediction-DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, GIFT Nifty, Kospi, Nikkei, Taiwan cues
item.description: Indian markets ended last week at nine-month highs, with the Nifty and Sensex rising for a fourth consecutive week as strong earnings and banking stocks supported gains. Global technology shares sold off sharply, while inflation, upcoming RBI policy and GDP data may keep domestic markets cautious.

item.description: Taiwan is considering lowering the margin requirement ratio for stock investors using borrowed funds as it tries to stem a selloff after the benchmark equity index’s worst week in 35 years.

item.description: Precious metals extended their selloff, with gold near a 14-month low and silver at its lowest since September 2025. Inflation concerns, stronger US yields and the dollar, Fed rate-hike expectations, and a potential slowdown in AI spending weighed on metals.

item.title: 52% rally in six months! Mukul Agrawal portfolio’s defence stock has 19% upside, says ICICI Direct - Do you own it?
item.description: PTC Industries shares rose 1.01% on Friday, while the stock gained about 23% in three months and 53% in six. ICICI Securities retained its Buy rating and ₹29,000 target, implying 19% upside, citing strong EBITDA growth and long-term aerospace and defence opportunities.

item.title: Trump’s Memecoin Gala Returns With Demand Down and Scrutiny Up
item.description: The first time Morten Christensen traded his way into a gala with President Donald Trump, it cost him about $1,200. The second time, about $500. This time, he says, he ended up making $6.

item.title: Stock market outlook: Nifty posts longest weekly winning streak in 5 months; will rally survive next week, Nov 23-27?
item.description: Nifty 50 gained nearly 2.2% for a fourth consecutive winning week, while banking and financial stocks led the rally. Analysts see a positive near-term outlook, with resistance near 26,000 and support around 25,100–25,550.

item.description: Many private credit firms believe Saudi Arabia offers an estimated $100 billion opportunity, potentially helping transform the Middle East into one of the biggest markets for the asset class. But deploying capital at the required scale and speed is proving difficult.

item.title: RVNL vs Texmaco Rail: Which railway stock deserves a place in your portfolio for long-term gains? Check target price
item.description: RVNL’s Q2 FY27 profit rose 8.3% year over year, while revenue fell 8.2%. Texmaco Rail’s consolidated profit jumped 73.7%, despite lower revenue and a decline in standalone profit.

item.title: New Sebi proposal could flip fates of key men at NSE, BSE
item.description: Proposed amendments to tenures of MDs of exchanges revise age-based limit to term-based limit. Ashishkumar Chauhan may be barred from another term at NSE because of his prior service at BSE, while Sundararaman Ramamurthy could continue at BSE beyond age 65 and potentially serve at another exchange.

item.title: PBOC Anchors Yuan With Stable Fix as Volatility Jumps After APEC
item.description: China’s central bank signaled it wants to curb sharp moves in the yuan with a largely steady fixing Friday, after the currency posted its biggest drop since March following a trilateral leaders’ meeting.

item.title: Anthropic and SpaceX IPOs bring Bitcoin prices down? Is investor money shifting from crypto to AI stocks? What’s next?
item.description: Bitcoin and Ether fell sharply before the Anthropic and SpaceX IPOs, raising questions about capital shifting from crypto to stocks. Analysts say the declines also reflect ETF outflows, liquidations and broader risk aversion.&nbsp;

item.title: Mint Explainer| How Sebi’s margin tweaks may boost agri commodities
item.description: Lower margin requirements can improve capital efficiency for traders and brokers, potentially encouraging greater participation in commodity derivatives.

item.title: WeWork India share price jumps 40% in 6 months; ICICI Direct sees 37% more gains ahead - Buy? Check Target
item.description: WeWork India shares fell 1.60% to ₹683.30 on Friday, extending weekly losses, but have gained about 40% in six months. ICICI Securities expects the company to fund planned capex internally and forecasts 22% revenue and EBITDA growth, maintaining a Buy rating with a ₹933 target.

item.title: What is future of gold rates? Price crash continues as AI selloff, Fed rate-hike concerns weigh on investors' sentiment
item.description: Gold fell for a fifth consecutive day, recording its steepest weekly decline since March as expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike, a stronger dollar, and a selloff in AI-linked stocks weighed on precious metals.
